definitions.short: a compact (because made by passing between pieces of flesh)
definitions.full: H1285. berith בְּרִית 285 noun feminine covenant (|| Aramaic קְיָם , διαθήκη ; constitutio ) — ׳ב Gen 9:13 199t.; suffix בְּרִיתִי 6:18 50t.; בְּרִיתְךָ Deut 33:9 ; בְּרִיתֶ֑ךָ Psa 44:18 11 t.; בְּרִיתְכֶם Isa 28:18 ; בְּרִיתֵךְ Ezek 16:61 ; בְּרִיתוֺ Exod 2:24 18 t.; — pact, compact, covenant . I. between men . 1 trety, alliance, league: Abraham and Amorites Gen 14:13 ; Edom and its allies Obadiah 7; with Philistines 21:27 , 32 (E) 26:28 (J); Jacob and Laban 31:44 (J); Joshua and Gibeonites Josh 9:6-7 , 11 , 15 , 16 (J); Israel and Canaanites Exod 23:32 ; 34:12 , 15 (JE) Deut 7:2 ; Judg 2:2 ; Ammonites and Jabesh 1Sam 11:1 ; Solomon and Hiram 1 Kings 5:26; Ahab and Benhadad 1Kin 20:34 ; Syria and Israel 15:19 2Chr 16:3 ; Nebuchadnezzar and Zedekiah Ezek 17:13-19 ; nations against Israel Psa 83:6 ; nations with Egypt Ezek 30:5 ; Ephraim and Assyria Hosea 12:2 ; Judah and Israel Ezek 16:61 ; Judah and Tyre Amos 1:9 ; Assyria and Judah Isa 33:8 ; ברית נגיד a prince in league (with him) Dan 11:22 (so He Ew; Hi Meinh Bev reference to high priest Onias III, & translate prince of covenant , compare AV RV); figurative, with death Isa 28:15 , 18 ; with stones of the field Job 5:23 . 2 constitution, ordinance , between monarch and subjects: David and Abner 2Sam 3:12-13 , 21 ; David and the elders of Israel 5:3 = 1Chr 11:3 ; Zedekiah and his people Jer 34:8-18 ; hostile prince and Israelites Dan 9:27 . 3 agreement, pledge: Jehoiada and captains 2Kin 11:4 2Chr 23:1 ; with onself Job 31:1 ; with Leviathan to be a servant Job 40:28; between man and man Hosea 10:4 compare ברית בעל Judg 8:33 ; 9:4 = ברית אל 9:46 . 4 alliance of friendship between David and Jonathan 1Sam 18:3 ; 20:8 ; 23:18 compare Psa 55:21 . 5 alliance of marriage Prov 2:17 ; Mal 2:14 . — In all cases ברית כרת is the technical phrase for making covenant except Jer 34:10 בברית באו ; Dan 9:27 לְ ברית הגביר . Various prepositions are used, most often לְ Exod 23:32 +, but also עִם Gen 26:28 +, אֵת 2Sam 3:12 +, בֵּין 2Chr 16:3 . II. between God and man . 1 alliance of friendship (|| סוֺד ) Psa 25:14 . 2 covenant , as a divine constitution or ordinance with signs or pledges (see אוֺת ). a. with Noah Gen 9:9-17 (P) Isa 54:10 ; Jer 33:20 , 25 ; a divine promise that there would be no other deluge. b. with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob Gen 15:18 (J) 17:2-21 Exod 2:24 ; 6:4-5 , Lev 26:42 (P) 2Kin 13:23 ; 1Chr 16:15 = Psa 105:8 ; 105:10 ; Neh 9:8 ; Jer 34:18 ; a promise to multiply their seed, give them the land of Canaan, and make them a blessing to the nations. c. with Israel at Sinai = Horeb, with a covenant sacrifice Exod 19:5 ; 24:7-8 , (E) 34:10 , 27 , 28 (J) 31:16 ; Lev 2:13 (P) 24:8 ; 26:9 , 15 , 25 , 44 , 45 (H) Deut 4:13 ; renewed in plains of Moab Deuteronomy 28:69; with blessings and curses 29:20 ; frequently referred to in other books 2Chr 34:32 ; Psa 25:10 ; 44:18 ; 50:5 ; 50:16 ; 74:20 ; 78:10 ; 78:37 ; 103:18 ; 106:45 ; 111:5 ; 111:9 ; Isa 56:4 , 6 ; Jer 1:2-3 , 6 , 8 , 10 ; 14:21 ; 22:9 ; 31:32 ; Ezek 16:8 , 59 , 60 ; 44:7 ; Dan 9:4 ; 11:28 , 30 , 32 ; Hosea 6:7 ; 8:1 ; Zech 9:11 ; 11:10 ; a divine constitution given to Israel with promises on condition of obedience and penalties for disobendience, in the form of tables of the covenant Deut 9:9 , 11 , 15 , inscribed with the ten words, placed in ברית(י ׅ׳ארון the ark of the covenant Num 10:33 40t. (see ארון ; in 1Sam 4:3-4 , (twice in verse); 4:5 omits ברית after ᵐ5 ארון We Dr); set forth in הברית דברי words of the covenant Exod 34:28 (J) Deuteronomy 28:69; Deut 29:8 ; 2Kin 23:3 (= 2Chr 34:31 ) Jer 11:2-8 ; written in הברית ספר the book of the covenant Exod 24:7 (E compare 34:27 J) 2Kin 23:2 , 21 (compare 2Chr 34:30 ). d. with Phinehas Num 25:12-13 , (P), a constitution, establishing an everlasting priesthood in his line; compare הכהנים ברית Neh 13:29 & הלוי ברית Mal 2:4 , 8 . e. with Joshua and Israel Josh 24:25 (E), an ordinance or constitutional agreement to serve Yahweh only. f. with David Psa 89:4 ; 89:29 ; 89:34 ; 89:39 ; 132:12 ; Jer 33:21 (compare 2 Samuel 7 = 1 Chronicles 17); a divine promise to the seed of David of an everlasting kingdom, the relation of sonship, and the superintendence of the temple (compare Psalms 2..) g. Jehoiada and the people 2Kin 11:17 2Chr 23:3 , a constitutional agreement to be the people of Yahweh. h. Hezekiah and the people 2Chr 29:10 , a constitutional agreement to reform the worship. i. Josiah and the people 2Kin 23:3 , a constitutional agreement to obey the book of the covenant. j. Ezra and the people Ezra 10:3 , a constitutional agreement to put away foreign wives and observe the Law. k. the prophetic covenant , a divine promise through a series of prophets to establish a new constitution חדשׁה ברית Jer 31:31 , with new institutions and precepts Isa 42:6 ; 49:8 ; 55:3 ; 59:21 ; 61:8 ; Jer 31:31 , 33 ; 32:40 ; 50:5 ; Ezek 16:60 , 62 ; 20:37 ; 34:25 ; 37:26 ; Hosea 2:20 . In Isa 2 the Messianic servant is עם ברית Isa 42:6 ; 49:8 , compare הברית מלאך Mal 3:1 . III. Phrases . 1 covenant making: ברית כרת Gen 15:18 ; Exod 34:10 , 27 (J) Josh 24:25 (E) Deut 5:2-3 , Deuteronomy 28:69; 29:13 ; 29:24 ; 1 Kings 5:26; 2Kin 11:17 ; 17:35 , 38 ; 23:3 ; 2Chr 21:7 ; 23:3 , 16 ; 29:10 ; 34:30 ; Ezra 10:3 ; Neh 9:8 ; Psa 50:5 ; 89:4 ; Isa 55:3 ; 61:8 ; Jer 11:10 ; 31:31-32 , 33 ; 32:40 ; 34:13 ; Ezek 34:25 ; 37:26 ; Hosea 2:20 ; ברית הקים establish a covenant Gen 6:18 ; 9:9 , 11 , 17 ; 17:7 , 19 , 21 ; Exod 6:4 (P) Ezek 16:60 , 62 , but confirm covenant Lev 26:9 (?;H) Deut 8:18 ; ברית נתן Gen 17:2 ; Num 25:12 (P); ברית שׂם 2Sam 23:5 (poetry); בברית עבר Deut 29:11 ; בברית בא 2Chr 15:12 ; Ezek 16:8 ; ברית צוה Psa 111:9 ; פי על ברית נשׂא 50:16 . (compare further on these Dr J Ph xi. 1882, 210 ff. ) 2 covenant keeping: on the part of man ברית שׁמר 1Kin 11:11 ; Neh 1:5 ; 9:32 ; Psa 78:10 ; 103:18 ; 132:12 ; Dan 9:4 , ברית נצר Deut 33:9 ; Psa 25:10 , בברית מחזיקים Isa 56:4 , 6 ; on the part of God ברית זכר Gen 9:15-16 , Exod 2:24 ; 6:5 (all P), Lev 26:42 (3 t. in verse) (H; on suffix compare Di Ges § 128 , 1 R b) 26:45 (H) Psa 105:8 ; 106:45 ; 111:5 ; 1Chr 16:15 ; Ezek 16:15 , 60 . Thus we have נאמנת Psa 89:29 ; עולם ברית Gen 9:16 ; 17:7 , 13 , 18 , 19 ; Exod 31:16 ; Lev 24:8 ; Num 18:19 ; 25:13 (P) 2Sam 23:5 (poetry) 1Chr 16:17 (= Psa 105:10 ) Isa 24:5 ; 55:3 ; 61:8 ; Jer 32:40 ; 50:5 ; Ezek 16:60 ; 37:26 ; מלח ברית Lev 2:13 ; 2Chr 13:5 ; 21:7 (a cov't. with sacrificial meal and salt; on cov't. with salt in Arabia compare We Skizzen iii. 124 ); שׁלום ברית Num 25:12 (P) Isa 54:10 ; Ezek 34:25 ; 37:26 ; והחסד הברית Deut 7:9 , 12 ; 1Kin 8:23 (= 2Chr 6:14 ) Neh 1:5 ; 9:32 ; Dan 9:4 ; קדשׁ ברית 11:28 , 30 ; הברית מסרת Ezek 20:37 . 3 covenant violation: ברית עבר Deut 17:2 ; Josh 7:11 , 15 ; 23:16 (D) Judg 2:20 ; 2Kin 18:12 ; Hosea 6:7 ; 8:1 ; ברית הפר Gen 17:14 ; Lev 26:15 , 44 (H) Deut 31:16 , 20 (J) Judg 2:1 ; Isa 24:5 (twice in verse); Jer 11:10 ; 14:21 ; 31:32 ; 33:20-21 , Ezek 16:59 ; 17:18-19 , 44:7 ; Zech 11:10 ; ברית עזב 1Kin 19:10 , 14 ; Jer 22:9 ; Dan 11:30 ; ברית מאס 2Kin 17:15 ; ברית נאר Psa 89:39 ; ברית חלל 89:34 ; Mal 2:10 ; בברית שׁקר Psa 44:18 ; ברית שׁכח Deut 4:23 , 31 ; Jer 50:5 . בְּרוֺת בְּרוֺשׁ, see below ברשׁ . בָּרוּת see below I. ברה . בֵּרֹתי בֵּרוֺ֫תָה, see below באר . ברז (? compare Aramaic כרז bore, pierce , or Arabic , appear ).
